scope: New formed-sheet upper PF231401 bracket study from oblique rear and front product photos: closed central aperture, two damper holes, two folded-ear holes and long upper flange. Replaces open-arch/flat-end interpretation; all metrics and current RDC fit remain estimates. Dampers, collars, boot, welds and hardware are separate missing children.
observations: Central circular aperture is closed, not a bottom cutaway
Two round damper seats visible in main web; two fastening apertures lie in turned-up ends
Long upper lip and return ears are finite sheet; no hidden backing insert
Rubber boot and two dampers in front photo are separate parts, not filled steel holes

authored_estimates.method: Bounded original dimensions from related product proportions; photos uncalibrated, no OEM/measured dimensions

remaining: Exact blank outline, metric bends and hole centres
Grommets, collars and central cable boot
Vehicle current RDC variant and installed pose

rejected_geometry_revision.reason: Actual exported normals check found minimum face/corner dot -0.114. Long perimeter cap edges crossed sheet bends without longitudinal subdivision; no material stage allowed.
rejected_geometry_revision.correction: Resample all perimeter edges to the same maximum pitch as the interior before constrained triangulation and bend. Same design coordinates, no hidden geometry.

revised_visible_contour.reason: Distinct front source shows both turned ear holes, inconsistent with an assumed90deg ear fold viewed along main-web normal; shallow concave lower edge also visible
revised_visible_contour.prior_gray_scope: Topology/bend diagnostic only, not a received or materialled source

actual_mesh_bounds_m.scope: Computed authored model only; not physical/OEM measurement
